title: Vektra Theme Profile Phase 1
description: Documents the semantic, Icon, and Button token surface required by Vektra phase 1 after DTCG token resolution.

tooltip.description: The original content token set remains all-or-none. Placement, arrow, viewport, and shadow tokens are optional extensions with runtime foundation/semantic fallbacks.

variant.description: Each Button variant requires the base state matrix and may add a complete selected state matrix (normal, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled). Themes without selected tokens remain compatible through runtime fallback.
